title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 9 — Protection from Extraordinary Collection Actions
content:
**9.1 Suspension.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), from the day an application is received until it is determined, every extraordinary collection action on the patient's eligible encounters is suspended (where the tier suspends collection on application): an ECA suspension notice is logged for each eligible encounter in bad debt status or past its final notice.

**9.2 After approval.** Within the ECA reversal days (calendar days) of the determination date, an agency recall request is logged for each covered encounter placed with the agency and a credit-report deletion request for each covered encounter credit-reported; within the refund review days, a refund review request is logged for each covered encounter whose payments exceed its FAP liability.

**9.3** Each action is logged once per encounter on a case.

**9.4 Denial.** A denial lifts the suspension, and collection resumes no sooner than the end of the notification period counted from the encounter's first statement.

### Action table

| Moment | Encounter condition | Action logged |
|---|---|---|
| application received, until determination | eligible encounter in bad debt status or past its final notice | ECA suspension notice |
| within the reversal days after approval | covered encounter placed with the agency | agency recall request |
| within the reversal days after approval | covered encounter credit-reported | credit-report deletion request |
| within the refund review days after approval | covered encounter whose payments exceed its FAP liability | refund review request |

One encounter can carry several different actions on one case, but never the same action twice.
